description: Doré plates (data/illustrations/dore-1866.json) that have no local WebP thumbnail yet. They were deferred from PR #25 so that the pull request could ship with the thumbnails that had been fetched. Pages show these plates from the Internet Archive IIIF Image API without a local placeholder. To finish: run npm run dore:thumbs (it fetches only the missing thumbnails), then remove each fetched plate from this list; when the list is empty, delete this file and the validator allowance for it.
note: On 2026-10-29 the Internet Archive IIIF Image API (iiif.archive.org, v2 and v3) returned HTTP 500 and 504 errors, or timed out, for most scaled requests of these plates, so their thumbnails could not be made.
